title: Rangeson - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Rangeson in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Rangeson is a dark-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Defense (C), Agility (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Rangeson
sections.content:
Location: Stone Wave Cliffs - merchant Jerijeri.

sections.title: Is the Rangeson Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (C), Agility (B). A dedicated dark pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
